These Petitions, Coming On For Admission, This
Day, Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J.M.Khazi
 Oral Order
Sri . Sharath Kumar, learned counsel has filed Vakalath for respondent.

2. Petitioner and respondent in Crl.P.No.5068/2023 who are petitioner and respondent in
Crl.P.No.7111/2023 are present.
3. Learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1 is also present.

4.  A copy of joint memo filed by the petitioner and respondent therein in Crl.Misc.No.558/2023 is produced, wherein as per Para No.(c), the respondent/wife NC: 2025:KHC:25158 HC-KAR has undertaken to withdraw the criminal proceedings filed against petitioner/husband.
5. As per Clause (b) of the said joint memo, respondent/wife reports receipt of gold ornaments as described in separate para and also cash in a sum of Rs.7,000/-.
6. Respondent/wife admit the compromise and submits that she has no objection to allow the petition.
The terms and conditions of compromise petition are legal and equitable.

The same is accepted and accordingly, following:
ORDER (i) Crl.P.No.5068/2023 and Crl.P.No.7111/2023 filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C are allowed.

(ii) The proceedings in CC.No.18281/2022 (Cr.No.9/2022) of Mysuru Women Police,
Mysuru on the file of XIII Addl.Civil Judge and JMFC, Mysuru for the offences NC:
2025:KHC:25158 HC-KAR punishable under Section 498A, 504, 506 IPC and proceedings in Crl.Misc.577/2022 on the file of Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC,
T.Narasipura for the offences punishable under Sections 9, 18 and 22 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act are hereby quashed.
